rights_holder: The Norris estate or authorized successor for name and likeness; Ian Spector and Penguin for the compiled books
underlying_work: Crowd-written text corpus, plus name, likeness, and registered marks
enforcement_history: Suit filed 21 December 2007 in the Southern District of New York against Penguin Group, Ian Spector, and Qubefactor, alleging trademark, false-endorsement, privacy/publicity, and related claims. A temporary restraining order to halt sales was denied the same day.
curatorial_note: The most instructive row in the register: this meme has no image, yet litigation still arose over the words, name, and commercial framing. Norris died on 19 March 2026; any name-and-likeness assessment must now account for the estate and jurisdiction-specific post-mortem rules. Sources disagree on whether the fact generator began in 2003 or summer 2005; the museum uses 2005, consistent with ADR 0002.
